description: Address code review feedback: fix stale page list in _startOcr, add clearOcrProgress flag to copyWith, wire extractWithPositions into searchable PDF for positional overlays, and surface OCR error count to users.
steps: 1. Fix stale page list in _startOcr: capture page IDs upfront, re-read state each iteration to get current page data by ID.
2. Add clearOcrProgress flag to ScannerState.copyWith paralleling clearActive/clearError, update finishOcr and clearOcr to use it.
3. Wire extractWithPositions into the searchable PDF pipeline: store OcrLine data per page, use positional overlay in PDF export.
4. Add OCR error tracking: add ocrFailedPages count to ScannerState, surface it in the text detection view when pages fail.
acceptance_criteria: _startOcr captures page IDs and re-reads state each iteration instead of using a stale pages list
ScannerState.copyWith has clearOcrProgress boolean flag that resets ocrProgressIndex to -1
finishOcr and clearOcr use the clearOcrProgress flag
extractWithPositions is used in PDF export for per-line positioned text overlay
ScanPage entity stores OcrLine positions data
OCR failures are tracked with a count and surfaced to users in the UI
All changes follow existing patterns and have correct Dart syntax
verification: Review all modified files for correct Dart syntax and pattern consistency
Verify clearOcrProgress flag works in copyWith
Verify extractWithPositions result is stored and used in PDF export
Verify failed page count is tracked and displayed
findings: All 4 review issues addressed plus a bonus share-text feature for the user request. No Flutter SDK in sandbox so verification is via code review. The extractWithPositions method is now the primary OCR path (dead code eliminated). The clearOcrProgress flag follows the same pattern as clearActive/clearError. The stale page list issue is resolved by ID-based iteration with per-iteration state re-reads. OCR failures are tracked and surfaced with a count banner. Share buttons added to both the text detection view and the text result bottom sheet.
